summary: §2.4.2, p. 39, lines 511–512. [highlight] On the text: «that already exists for other purposes:».
comment:
§2.4.2, p. 39, lines 511–512. [highlight] On the text: «that already exists for other purposes:».
this is not clear:
What do you mean for "other purposes"?
Lots of countries don't have all these registries at all. Facility registry and health workforce registry are probably the ones most frequently being available, but not the others.
So may rephrase last sentence just above table:
"these capabilites draw or would ideally draw on shared DPI that is also used for managing the health workforce, supply chains and other health system domains.
